en.gamble_rules:
To double any winnings, click on the DOUBLE button.
Then click on the RED, BLACK, or select a SUIT.
The number of games is limited by the maximum win {%n}.
When the limit is reached, the possibility of increasing the winnings will not be available.
If the color RED/BLACK is guessed correctly, the winnings are doubled (x2).
If the SUIT is guessed correctly, the winnings are quadrupled (x4).
If the choice is wrong, all current winnings are burned out and the game ends.
en.poker_rules:
video poker game is played with one deck of cards (52 cards).
A game consists of two rounds. Five cards are being dealt. At the end of the first round the player can select which cards to hold.
After the first round, if the game maintains Auto Hold mode, the player will be offered which cards are best for him/her to hold, as those cards are automatically marked.
The player can deselect those cards and mark different ones, as he wishes.
The rest of the cards are “disposed”. A second round starts, after the selection of the cards that will be held is made.
The “disposed” cards are replaced with different cards from the deck of cards.
If there is a winning combination, at the end of the second round, the player wins that amount. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
en.lines_rules: All pays are left to right on adjacent reels, on selected lines, beginning with the leftmost reel, except scatters. Scatter wins are added to the payline wins. Highest payline add/or scatter wins only paid. Line wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line. Scatter wins are multiplied by the total bet value. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
en.lines_rules_no_scatter: All pays are left to right on adjacent reels, on selected lines, beginning with the leftmost reel. Highest payline wins only paid. Line wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
en.keno_rules: Player wager by choosing numbers ranging from 1 through 80. Player can choose from 1 to 10 numbers. After player make wager, 20 numbers are drawn at random. Winning is calculated according to the paytable depending on the numbers chosen by the player and the matches between the drawn numbers and the selected numbers. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
en.roshambo_rules: Game has three possible outcomes: a draw, a win or a loss. The player who decides to choose a stone will beat the other player who chose scissors, but will lose to the one who played paper. If the player chooses paper, he will lose to the player who chose scissors, but will win the one who chose stone. The player who chose scissors wins over the player who chooses paper, but loses to the player who chooses stone. If the players choose the same form the result of the game is a draw. If there are all three forms in the round the result is a draw. There can be multiple winners in a round. If only one player wins, it is an absolute victory. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.

en.fs_rules:
Daily Spins (DS) are calculated as follows: the sum of all wagered funds in AGT software games, except for poker and keno games, from the moment of the previous accrual (up to a maximum of 10 days), minus the sum of all winnings for the same period multiplied by the DS coefficient. The DS coefficient for new players is 4.5%. The DS coefficient increases by 0.5% every day if the player bets on games, except for poker and keno games, on that day. If the player does not bet on any games, except for poker and keno games, the DS coefficient decreases by 1%. The DS coefficient cannot be less than 4.5% or more than 10%.
DS is credited at the moment of entering the game if 8 hours have passed since the last bet. The day is considered in the UTC time zone. After accepting DS, it must be played within 20 minutes to be eligible for rewards.

en.info_intro_body:
The playfield is a pyramid of pegs down which a ball randomly travels toward one of many prize slots.

Lucky Drop is a game of chance based on the Plinko mechanic.
en.info_howto_body:
Choose your bet size and press the Play button.

After launch, the ball starts moving from top to bottom across the playfield. As it falls, the direction of movement is determined randomly at each collision with a peg.

Once it reaches the bottom of the field, the ball lands in one of the prize slots. The payout is calculated as the bet amount multiplied by the multiplier of the corresponding slot.

If you hold the button, the balls will drop automatically one after another.

Malfunction voids all results.
en.info_feat_risk_body: The player can choose a risk level: Low, Medium or High. The risk level affects the placement of multipliers on the playfield and the overall volatility of the game.
en.info_feat_rows_body: The player can choose the number of rows on the playfield. Changing the number of rows affects the ball's trajectory and the available multipliers.
en.info_feat_balls_body: This feature allows you to launch several balls in a row within a single game session.
en.info_feat_portal_body: A special feature that can be activated through the Buy Features section. When the ball hits a portal, it gets an additional pass across the playfield while keeping the current win.
en.info_feat_lines_body: When this feature is active, special multiplier zones appear on the playfield. Passing the ball through such a zone increases the final win by an additional coefficient.
en.info_feat_mball_body: This feature increases the probability of special balls with additional x2 or x4 multipliers appearing.
en.info_feat_bonus_body: A special event during which additional bonus elements may appear on the playfield, granting increased multipliers or extra winning opportunities.
en.info_payouts_body:
All wins are calculated based on the final multiplier obtained by the ball after it finishes moving across the playfield.

If additional features or bonuses are active during play, their multipliers are summed or applied according to the rules of the specific feature.

A malfunction of the game software voids all bets and wins.

The Wild symbol appears only on reels 2, 3 and 4 and substitutes for all symbols. The Wild symbol has no payouts of its own.
en.gemflare_info_lines_rules: Wins are calculated according to winning combinations shown in the pay table. Winning combinations are formed on adjacent reels on the 10 fixed paylines, from left to right and from right to left. Only the highest win per line in each direction is paid. Wins from left to right and from right to left on the same line are added together; a combination covering all 5 reels is paid in both directions. When several winning combinations occur, all wins are summed. Each winning combination is multiplied by the bet per line. Expanding Wild: when a Wild lands on reel 2, 3 or 4, it expands to cover the entire reel, wins are calculated with the expanded Wild, and the reel is held in place while the other reels are respun. Several Wilds landing on the same spin award a single respin. Any new Wild landing during a respin also expands, is held and awards one more respin. Up to 3 respins can be played in a row. Respins are played at the same bet as the spin that triggered them. Wins from the triggering spin and all respins are added together and paid at the end of the feature.
